actual: C-012-RL1-HR1 formal 24-fit replay completed 5/24 fits then failed in fold-1 train interaction. The approved L2 market carrier retained 392/405 dates because 13 May-2022 dates had fewer than 118 valid L2 sectors; L1 retained all 405 dates. market_relative_ridge_candidate._condition_component currently maps any missing same-day market state to fatal hmm_risk_market_conditioning_identity_mismatch, so approved D4 coverage/abstention and prediction-only/outcome-only accounting never execute. Fix must retain canonical dates, L2 minimum 118, L1 denominator 31, folds, market K/lambda/seed, Ridge alpha/features/target and all product thresholds. Missing market-conditioned rows must become typed unavailable/abstention with exact date/sector/hash evidence, never default/forward-filled state, never silently dropped from coverage denominators, and invalid date keys/states must remain fatal. No HMM refit during BUG implementation; formal replay resumes only after merged verified source.
